Low Bank Hop.name: Low Bank Hop
Low Bank Hop.description: The user springs up to six meters across a gap or three meters upward and grips a firm landing with their hands and feet this turn. This reaches a low balcony or clears an obstacle without a running start. The user needs a stable takeoff and a landing they can see; the leap cannot change direction in midair and adds no protection from a bad fall. Strain: light.
